plainText:
Kazuyuki Okitsu (Japanese: 興津和幸 Okitsu Kazuyuki) is a Japanese voice actor for .

==Biography==
Okitsu was born on March 8, 1980, in , , . Okitsu first worked on the during . His only role so far is Ulu, 's brother.
